name: Robin Healthcare
description: Robin Healthcare is an ambient AI scribe distinguished by its dedicated hardware device (Robin Assistant) that sits in exam rooms rather than relying on smartphones or computer microphones. The platform saves physicians 90 minutes/day on documentation with 98% patient acceptance rates. Robin has raised $82M+ in funding and integrates with Epic, Cerner, and athenahealth. Key differentiator: purpose-built hardware may provide better audio quality and HIPAA boundaries than mobile-based alternatives. Enterprise pricing requires sales contact—no published rates. Best for established health systems ready to invest in dedicated documentation infrastructure; not for solo practices, telehealth-only, or budget-conscious small groups.

faqs.q: What is the Robin Assistant device?
faqs.a: The Robin Assistant is a dedicated hardware device that sits in exam rooms to capture patient-physician conversations. Unlike software-only AI scribes that use phone or computer microphones, Robin uses purpose-built hardware for ambient documentation with clearer HIPAA boundaries.

faqs.q: How much does Robin Healthcare cost in 2026?
faqs.a: Robin Healthcare requires enterprise pricing quotes. The hardware-based model includes device costs, installation, and per-provider software subscription. Contact their sales team for specific pricing based on your practice size and deployment needs.

faqs.q: How much time does Robin Healthcare save physicians?
faqs.a: Robin Healthcare reports that physicians save an average of 90 minutes per day on documentation tasks using the ambient AI scribe system.

faqs.q: Do patients accept the Robin device in exam rooms?
faqs.a: Yes. Robin Healthcare reports 98% patient acceptance rates for the Robin Assistant device in clinical settings. The dedicated hardware may feel less intrusive than clinicians using phones during visits.

faqs.q: Robin Healthcare vs Freed or Commure: which is better?
faqs.a: Robin is hardware-based with dedicated devices and enterprise pricing. Freed ($39-119/mo) and Commure ($59-89/mo) are software-only with mobile apps—much cheaper and faster to deploy. Choose Robin if you want dedicated infrastructure and HIPAA-clear hardware; choose software alternatives for flexibility and lower cost.
